name: zrndr_lens_flare_draw_queued_samples16_and_build_visible_list
description: zRndr_LensFlare_DrawQueuedSamples16_AndBuildVisibleList visibility-tests queued lens-flare samples from a start index, removes occluded samples by compacting the queue, and appends enabled visible samples from the first 64 slots.
known_limits: Binary Ninja keeps a limited reconstruction marker because the x87 compare against zero still renders as a flag expression assigned through lensFlareSource.w, while assembly only tests sample->invDepth > 0 before appending the sample pointer.
VC5SP3 compile-only verification is recorded for the production source body; tier S byte comparison is deferred to a coherent zRndr lens-flare pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x49a920 validates the fastcall start index, early return when startIndex reaches the queue count, point-visibility test, backfill compaction on invisible samples, enabled-source check at +0x0c, first-64-slot cap, nonzero reciprocal-Z gate, and visible-def append.

The native smoke verifies the early return, occlusion-failure queue compaction from the requested start index, visible sample append, zero-depth rejection, disabled-source rejection, and preservation of the queued sample count when all tested samples are visible.
